sources.entry: Convertino - Drag a file, tap Shift and drop it on a radial menu to convert or edit it. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/hasanzadee/convertino) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A radial file converter and quick editor for Windows, Linux and macOS: drag a file, tap Shift, and drop it on a petal of a pop-up flower menu to convert or edit it.
summary.what_it_does: Convertino opens a radial "flower" menu under the cursor while a file is being dragged and Shift (or another chosen key) is tapped. Dropping the file on a petal runs that conversion or edit, and the result is written beside the original without overwriting anything. Rings cover image formats (PNG, JPG, WEBP, AVIF, PDF, and more via ImageMagick), documents, data formats (JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, CSV, XLSX), video and audio via ffmpeg, subtitles, text encodings, archives, and checksums. Image editors include crop, annotate, redact, adjust, and an offline AI background cut-out. It also handles clipboard and screen-area captures through global shortcuts, custom "recipe" chains of steps, user-defined command petals, watch folders, and a CLI (convertino convert, run, recipe, watch, and others).
use_cases: compress and resize images for the web
convert documents or slides to PDF
convert JSON, YAML, XML and CSV between formats
extract archives or verify SHA-256 checksums
batch convert files in a watch folder
how_to_run: Windows: download convertino-win-x64.zip from the latest release, unzip, and run install.ps1 (powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1)
Linux: download convertino-linux-x64.tar.gz, then: tar xf convertino-linux-x64.tar.gz && cd convertino && ./install.sh
macOS: paste into Terminal: curl -fsSL | bash (or download the macOS zip and run ./install.sh)
Optional AI cut-out model: convertino model install
Build from source (.NET 10 SDK): git clone the repo, then run the platform script under packaging/ (for example ./packaging/linux/install.sh)
notable: Radial 'flower' menu opened by dragging a file and tapping Shift; a live preview shows result sizes on each petal before you drop
Offline by design: conversions, OCR and AI cut-out run locally; the only network calls are an optional model download and an optional update check
Recipes chain several petals into one action, and user-defined commands run programs without a shell
Works across Windows, Linux (X11, with Wayland limits) and macOS, with browser drag-and-drop support
Downloads from the browser are checked: only http, https and data URLs, redirects checked, and the real file type is read from the content
caveats: Gesture needs global pointer and keyboard access; on Wayland the drag gesture doesn't work, so right-click menus or the clipboard flower are the fallback
The macOS build is not notarized by Apple, so Gatekeeper warnings need a manual override; the Cut out petal is unavailable on Intel Macs
Many petals need extra software: ffmpeg for video and audio, LibreOffice or Microsoft Office for office formats, Ghostscript for PDF compression
